boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten campus places for studying, making, technical help, recreation, gaming, gathering, and taking a nature break between classes.

cards.entity_name: Arboretum and Botanical Garden at Cal State Fullerton
cards.title: Trade Campus Pavement for Garden Paths
cards.subtitle: A 26-acre botanical garden at the north end of campus
cards.notes: Walk the garden paths between classes, or check the official calendar for student-led events and volunteer opportunities on the grounds.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge botanical garden where students can walk, volunteer, attend events, and participate in environmental learning.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies the Arboretum as a 26-acre garden on the north end of campus and documents student events, internships, and volunteer activities there.
cards.source_title: Arboretum and Botanical Garden at Cal State Fullerton
cards.access_notes: Consult the official site for current garden access, event information, and any activity-specific registration requirements.

cards.title: Use the Union as an Between-Class Base
cards.subtitle: Study and gathering space at the center of student life
cards.notes: Bring coursework or meet classmates in the union’s public study areas, then use the building map to locate services and event rooms.
cards.short_summary: A multiuse student center combining study areas, meeting space, campus services, food options, and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Associated Students states that the Titan Student Union provides study space, event space, student art galleries, recreation, food service, and student offices.
cards.source_title: Associated Students, CSUF | Titan Student Union
cards.access_notes: Building and individual service hours vary by term; check the operating-hours section before visiting.

cards.title: Log In for a Campus Gaming Break
cards.subtitle: Student gaming space inside the Titan Student Union
cards.notes: Use your student email to access a lounge PC, or look for scheduled tournaments if you want a structured multiplayer session.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated TSU gaming room with student-login PCs, consoles, casual play, and organized tournaments.
cards.evidence_claim: Associated Students documents the Esports Lounge inside the Titan Student Union, its gaming equipment and tournaments, and student-email login for the PCs.
cards.source_title: Associated Students, CSUF | Titan Student Union — Esports Lounge
cards.access_notes: PC use requires a CSUF student-email login; consult the TSU page for current building and lounge availability.

cards.title: Find the Games Center Below the Main Floor
cards.subtitle: Bowling and billiards in the Titan Student Union lower level
cards.notes: Head to the union’s lower level for bowling or billiards, and verify current Games Center availability before organizing a group visit.
cards.short_summary: The student union’s named recreation area for bowling and billiards, currently operated as part of the TSU Games Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Associated Students identifies Titan Bowl & Billiards as a Titan Student Union amenity and lists the TSU Games Center’s current operating status.
cards.source_title: Associated Students, CSUF | Titan Student Union — Games Center
cards.access_notes: The current summer listing says the Games Center is closed except for reserved events; verify term-specific availability before going.

cards.title: Activate the Recreation Access You Already Have
cards.subtitle: Fitness, pool, courts, climbing, and recreation programs
cards.notes: Activate your student membership before arrival, then check the day’s pool, climbing-wall, and open-court schedules separately.
cards.short_summary: A student recreation facility with fitness areas, courts, a pool, climbing, classes, and organized programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Associated Students says currently enrolled CSUF students receive complimentary SRC membership through the Campus Union Fee and documents the facility’s programs and operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Current students must activate membership; under-18 students need a signed waiver. Facility-area schedules and closures vary.

cards.title: Turn an Assignment Into Something Physical
cards.subtitle: Making rooms on Pollak Library North’s second floor
cards.notes: Check in at the second-floor service desk, reserve specialized equipment when needed, and review material rules before starting a project.
cards.short_summary: A library makerspace offering tools for fabrication, sewing, podcasting, bookmaking, virtual reality, and other creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Pollak Library states that its second-floor Makerspace supports making and collaboration with equipment including cutters, sewing machines, a podcast studio, and VR headsets.
cards.source_title: Makerspaces in the Library | CSUF Pollak Library
cards.access_notes: Check in at the PLN second-floor service desk. Reservations are available for certain equipment, and walk-ins are accepted during open hours.

cards.title: Reserve the High-Tech Collaboration Stations
cards.subtitle: Advanced technology in Pollak Library North room 215
cards.notes: Reserve a station up to one week ahead for VR, scanning, robotics, or display-board work; bring collaborators where the station permits.
cards.short_summary: A reservable technology center for experimentation with virtual reality, 3D tools, robotics, computing, and digital collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF Information Technology locates the Innovation Center in PLN 215 and allows enrolled students to reserve its technology stations for sessions of up to two hours.
cards.source_title: Innovation Center / Makerspace | CSUF Information Technology
cards.access_notes: Stations are for currently enrolled students, require reservations, and may be booked up to one week in advance for sessions of up to two hours.

cards.title: Bring Device Problems to the Library Desk
cards.subtitle: Peer-facing technology help in Pollak Library North
cards.notes: Stop just past the first-floor elevators for help connecting devices, installing campus software, or arranging a short-term equipment checkout.
cards.short_summary: An in-person student technology desk for wireless, software, device, website, and loaner-equipment assistance.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF Information Technology locates the Student Genius Center on Pollak Library North’s first floor and lists device setup, software, checkout, and technical-help services.
cards.source_title: Student Genius Center | CSUF Information Technology
cards.access_notes: In-person service is on Pollak Library North’s first floor; desk hours follow library operations and may change.

cards.title: Ask Here When Technology Access Is the Barrier
cards.subtitle: Device-access support on Pollak Library North’s second floor
cards.notes: Visit CEDA to discuss device access or TitanWare support, but allow extra time because approvals and hold removals stop before closing.
cards.short_summary: A campus technology-access center connecting students with devices, training, and the TitanWare ecosystem.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF states that CEDA provides devices and technology-ecosystem access for students and locates the center on Pollak Library North’s second floor.
cards.source_title: Center for Equitable Digital Access | CSUF
cards.access_notes: The posted summer schedule is Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–6 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; approvals and hold removals stop after 4:30 p.m.

cards.title: Spread Out With a Laptop and a Whiteboard
cards.subtitle: Open lab and collaborative workspace above the library
cards.notes: Bring a laptop for a docking station or use an available PC, then borrow a portable whiteboard when your group needs room to map ideas.
cards.short_summary: An open library floor combining computers, laptop docks, collaborative work areas, whiteboards, and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF Information Technology identifies Pollak Library North’s fourth floor as an open lab with PCs, laptop docking stations, collaborative workspace, portable whiteboards, and printing.
cards.source_title: Pollak Library North, 4th Floor | CSUF Information Technology
cards.access_notes: Computer login requires campus credentials. The area is self-service, and access follows current Pollak Library hours.
